DeleteOrganizationsByIdOrgResponse.description:
Empty response object returned on successful deletion of a Trello organization.

The Trello DELETE /1/organizations/{id} endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK with an empty
response body upon successful deletion. This is consistent with the documented behavior
of other DELETE operations in the Trello API.
